```yaml
name: Meshery UI Integration Test

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '**'
      - '!system/**'
      - '!*.md'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test-meshery-integration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [20]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout Sistent
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: layer5io/sistent
          path: sistent

      - name: Setup Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: sistent/package-lock.json

      - name: Install Sistent dependencies
        working-directory: sistent
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build Sistent
        working-directory: sistent
        run: npm run build

      - name: Package Sistent
        working-directory: sistent
        run: npm pack

      - name: Verify tarball creation
        working-directory: sistent
        run: |
          TARBALL=$(ls layer5io-sistent-*.tgz 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)
          if [ -z "$TARBALL" ]; then
            echo "::error::No tarball found after npm pack"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "TARBALL_NAME=$TARBALL" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Checkout Meshery UI
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: meshery/meshery
          path: meshery-ui

      - name: Setup Node.js for Meshery UI
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: meshery-ui/package-lock.json

      - name: Install Sistent into Meshery UI
        working-directory: meshery-ui
        run: |
          npm install ../sistent/${{ env.TARBALL_NAME }}

      - name: Install Meshery UI dependencies
        working-directory: meshery-ui
        run: npm ci

      - name: Check for test script
        id: check-test
        working-directory: meshery-ui
        run: |
          if grep -E '"test"\s*:' package.json; then
            echo "HAS_TEST=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "HAS_TEST=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Run Meshery UI tests
        if: steps.check-test.outputs.HAS_TEST == 'true'
        working-directory: meshery-ui
        run: npm test -- --ci --reporters=default --reporters=jest-junit
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Build Meshery UI
        working-directory: meshery-ui
        run: npm run build

      - name: Upload Test Results
        if: always() && steps.check-test.outputs.HAS_TEST == 'true'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: meshery-ui-test-results
          path: meshery-ui/junit.xml
          retention-days: 5

      - name: Report Results
        if: always()
        run: |
          if [ "${{ steps.check-test.outputs.HAS_TEST }}" == "true" ]; then
            echo "## Meshery UI Integration Test Results" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            echo "- **Status**: ${{ job.status }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            echo "- **Tests Run**: Yes" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          else
            echo "## Meshery UI Integration Test Results" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            echo "- **Status**: ${{ job.status }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            echo "- **Tests Run**: No (no test script found in Meshery UI)" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          fi
          echo "- **Sistent Version**: ${{ env.TARBALL_NAME }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
```
